purpose: Advisory smart-component recognition for Tailwind snippets. These hints never inject sf-code automatically; they report where SF5 smart behavior may be relevant.

hints.title: Search behavior
hints.strategy: Consider sf-code="search" only when the source behavior is an interactive search flow, not a plain input field.

hints.title: Select/filter behavior
hints.strategy: Consider sf-code="select" when source filters rely on selectable options and the target SF5 project uses smart select components.

hints.title: Pagination behavior
hints.strategy: Consider sf-code="pagination" only after confirming page-change behavior, URL policy, and loading state.

hints.title: Table behavior
hints.strategy: Prefer static semantic <table class="table ..."> output today. Treat sf-code="table" as registry-only and blocked for auto-promotion until a source-backed ui-smart table runtime/data contract exists.

hints.title: Cards behavior
hints.strategy: Consider sf-code="cards" when repeated cards need dynamic list behavior, filtering, selection, or async data loading.
